sourceBrief: User-supplied SLINGSIP LANDING PAGE - INTERACTION STORYBOARD, attachment 7243b242-5aa0-4e49-9a97-4283c7e1c4b0

architecture.mascot: One persistent traveler; existing approved PNG poses; no new character identity
architecture.motion: GSAP + ScrollTrigger; geometry-derived ordered viewport-relative frames; desktop pin lasts 2.15 viewport heights; SVG web retraction before reconnection
architecture.pointer: One smoothed demand-driven RAF on desktop fine pointers; approximately 10px/8px mascot offset, <=2.4 degree dashboard tilt; stops when converged or hidden
architecture.reducedMotion: No cinematic pin, large swing or cursor parallax; reminder/progress remain usable together; live preference changes clean up contexts
architecture.data: Browser-only demonstrations. No desktop bridge, IPC, persistence, profile data, settings writes, scheduler or installer changes.
architecture.future: Gmail/email, interview, meeting and smart sidekick alerts are labeled COMING IN V2 concepts only.
architecture.downloads: Public unauthenticated latest-release API; exact official stable x64 EXE URL validation; 5s timeout; safe releases-page fallback; no automatic download or install
architecture.storyPercentages: Approximate narrative beats from responsive section geometry; not a rigid global scroll-percentage timeline

issuesResolved: Decorative mobile hero orbit caused horizontal overflow; clipped to hero.
Fast scrolling could finish progress at 48%; final state now explicitly completes at 50%.
Bottle feedback overlapped a reminder button; moved to the free hand with separated feedback.
Future section badge could scroll beneath header; made sticky with persistent per-card V2 labels.
Screenshot automation could target X during reopen movement; wait for settle and assert closed scene before capture. Pointer regression covers stable interaction.
limitations: Live installer navigation awaits a compatible public GitHub release; fallback remains available.
Firefox, Safari and physical mobile devices have not been exercised.
Visibility regression simulates document hidden events; this is not an OS-level minimized-window test.
Existing raster poses are used for body/expression direction; independent eye/head rig animation requires appropriate artwork.
Existing bottle raster/mask remains the approved source; no replacement high-resolution artwork was invented.
Full desktop regression suite was not rerun for this isolated landing page. Previously documented desktop native-pointer harness limitation is unchanged.
manualChecklist: Open the local preview; slowly scroll down and back up through every chapter.
Click Drank it before auto celebration; check bottle pendulum and uncluttered feedback; finish at 50%.
Close/reopen the mock dashboard with pointer and Tab/Enter.
Resize and toggle reduced motion; content and controls must remain usable.
Review V2 labels and current unsigned warning.
After publishing separately is authorized, verify real official installer download with a compatible stable release.
Review on Safari/Firefox and a physical mobile device before hosting.
